# Worth My Fee

> Worth My Fee audits whether each premium credit card's annual fee pays for itself, from the cardholder's own transactions: which credits were actually used, which ones the spending can reach, and whether to keep, downgrade or cancel each card. The public catalog covers 91 cards and 229 credits, each cited to issuer pages.

## Data
- [Card credits that expire December 31, 2026](https://worthmyfee.com/credits/expiring-december-31/): every calendar-year credit on 39 annual-fee cards with the amount that resets December 31, and a picker for your own cards.
- [All cards](https://worthmyfee.com/cards/): annual fee, credits and break-even for every card in the catalog.
- [Portal hotel credits](https://worthmyfee.com/credits/portal-hotel/): every card that has one.
- [Global Entry, TSA PreCheck and CLEAR credits](https://worthmyfee.com/credits/trusted-traveler/): every card that has one.
- [Airline incidental fee credits](https://worthmyfee.com/credits/airline-fee/): every card that has one.
- [Companion certificates and fares](https://worthmyfee.com/credits/companion/): every card that has one.
- [Hotel credits and free-night awards](https://worthmyfee.com/credits/hotel/): every card that has one.
- [Anniversary bonuses](https://worthmyfee.com/credits/anniversary/): every card that has one.
- [Business software and services credits](https://worthmyfee.com/credits/business/): every card that has one.
- [Streaming and entertainment credits](https://worthmyfee.com/credits/streaming/): every card that has one.
- [Rideshare and chauffeur credits](https://worthmyfee.com/credits/rideshare/): every card that has one.
- [Dining and delivery credits](https://worthmyfee.com/credits/dining/): every card that has one.
- [Airline and flight credits](https://worthmyfee.com/credits/airline/): every card that has one.
- [General travel credits](https://worthmyfee.com/credits/travel/): every card that has one.
- [Lifestyle, wellness and shopping credits](https://worthmyfee.com/credits/lifestyle/): every card that has one.

## About
- [Methodology](https://worthmyfee.com/methodology/): how a card is scored from 12 months of transactions.
- [About](https://worthmyfee.com/about/): who maintains the catalog; paid by users, never by issuers.
